An '''Imperial captain''' was the [[Captain/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage's]] [[Sate Pestage's yacht|private yacht]]. When Pestage fled [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] accused him of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he gave the yacht to its captain.
